name: Shakuhachi Hammer
inspired_by: E-mu Emulator II 'Shakuhachi' (Peter Gabriel 'Sledgehammer' intro; also Fairlight SHAKUHACHI)
character: Breathy chiff burst then a hollow, almost-sine flute tone that bends up into pitch; the whole charm is the noisy overblown attack and a short, slightly falling tail. Mono, dry, 8-bit-era grit.
recipe_steps: Layer 1: a steady chunk of ringout (sine-ish ringback tone) is the hollow body; trim to its stable middle with @30[@40].
Layer 2: the first 8% of recycle (paper crumple) at x4 speed is the breath chiff; F keeps it unpitched.
[planned env graph] pitch is not available, so fake the 'scoop' with a volume graph: 0 to 100% in 15 ms, a 60 ms dip to 80%, then hold. That reads as an overblown attack.
[planned offsets] start the chiff recorder 0 ms and the body 25 ms later, so the breath is heard first.
[planned macro] M1 = chiff level (layer-2 vol 0 to 150%).

name: Emulator Choir Arr
inspired_by: E-mu Emulator I/II choir and the Fairlight ARR1 'Aah' (the 80s sampled choir)
character: Dark, lo-fi 'aah' with a slow swell, little top end and a grainy 8-bit sheen; vibrato comes from the ensemble, not an LFO.
recipe_steps: notify slowed an octave and turned down sits in the vocal formant range; three-voice unison at +/-14 cents makes it a section.
logon two octaves down, with its attack cut off, adds a breathy wash.
Keep the 8-bit grit: on the 3.11 edition, build it from chimes<< with ><, the decimation round trip.
[planned env graph] a 350 ms S-curve attack and a 1.1 s release with a small hump, like breath.

name: Emulator Marcato Strings
inspired_by: E-mu Emulator II 'Marcato Strings' / Emulator III Strings
character: Short bowed attack with rosin noise, fast 200 ms decay into a sustained but dark body; slightly stepped, low-sample-rate texture.
recipe_steps: Middle of logoff (string shimmer) as the sustained body, unison x3 for section width.
A tiny x8 crumple transient gives the bow noise.
[planned env graph] fast 20 ms rise, 250 ms drop to 60%, hold. That is the 'marcato' accent.

name: Proteus Pizzicato
inspired_by: E-mu Proteus/1 and Proteus/2 'Pizzicato' (90s TV and game score staple)
character: A very short plucked attack, 150 to 250 ms decay, no sustain; woody, mid-heavy, with a small room tail.
recipe_steps: Keep only the first 10% of xpringin (marimba-like ring phrase) as one plucked note.
One echo adds the 'section in a room' smear.
[planned offsets] 2 recorders 0 / 9 ms apart for a section flam.
Also try default@15] (XP Default's mallet bong).

name: Proteus/2 Orchestral Tutti
inspired_by: E-mu Proteus/2 Orchestral 'Tutti' / 'Strings+Brass' and the stacked-orchestra presets
character: Strings, brass and timpani in one big octave-stacked chord. Slow-ish attack, broad stereo, and a long hall release.
recipe_steps: tada with its first transient cut off acts as the brass section; harmony gives octaves.
Mid-logoff an octave below is the string bed.
The critstop low hit, slowed, is the timpani/bass drum on the downbeat.
[planned macro] M1 = brass vs strings crossfade.

name: Proteus World Kalimba
inspired_by: E-mu Proteus World / Planet Earth 'Kalimba' (also Alchemy and Omnisphere kalimbas)
character: A thumb-pluck click, then a clean, slightly inharmonic tine tone. 400 to 700 ms decay with a soft woody body; very 'Aero'.
recipe_steps: The front of xpding gives a bright tine.
The start.wav click at x2 speed is the thumb.
Mix them in one buffer instead: xpding@25]Mstart, if you want a single-recorder voice.
[planned offsets] click at 0 ms, tine at 3 ms.
Play an octave higher with T12 for music-box shimmer.

name: Planet Phatt Hip-Hop Kit
inspired_by: E-mu Planet Phatt / Mo'Phatt drum kits (90s hip-hop and R&B ROM)
character: Punchy, slightly crunchy drums: a boomy kick, a short snare crack and tight hats. The drums are mono and up front, with some 12-bit sampler bite.
recipe_steps: Layer 1: the attack of critstop at -2 octaves, clipped with ++, gives the kick boom.
Layer 2: a crumple grain at x4 is the snare and hat noise.
Layer 3: start.wav at x4 is the rim/hat tick.
Velocity at full (V100); every layer F, so each sound stays at one pitch. Map them to keys via the future per-key split, or play each layer alone.
Use >< (the decimation round trip) for SP-1200 grit.

name: Mo'Phatt Fat Bass
inspired_by: E-mu Mo'Phatt / Orbit 'Phat bass' presets
character: A round, sub-heavy, slightly distorted synth bass with a quick 'thump' decay into a sustained tone. Mono.
recipe_steps: The front of XP Error two octaves down is the low two-note, cut to the first tone.
+++ hard-clips it into a fat square-ish wave.
A third octave down mixed under it is the sub.
[planned env graph] 180 ms decay to 75% gives the 'thump'.

name: Orbit Dance Stab
inspired_by: E-mu Orbit 9090 dance stabs and hits (late-90s rave and big beat)
character: A short, loud, chordal hit with a bright transient and some noisy rave grit. It decays in 250 ms.
recipe_steps: The first third of chord.wav, clipped with ++ and echoed once, gives the stab.
H0,7 adds a fifth for the rave power-chord.

name: Vintage Keys Rhodes
inspired_by: E-mu Vintage Keys 'Suitcase' / 'Stage 73' Rhodes
character: Bell-like tine on top of a warm, sine-ish body. It barks a little when you play hard, sustains long, and has a gentle stereo tremolo.
recipe_steps: XP Default's soft mallet is the tine strike.
A steady ringout chunk an octave down is the sine body.
[planned pan] stereo tremolo: alternate recorders L60 and R60 at the same volume and use the planned volume automation on M1 for the tremolo.
[planned macro] M2 = bark (adds a ++ clipped copy layer at high velocity).

name: Vintage Keys Mellotron Flute
inspired_by: E-mu Vintage Keys 'Mellotron Flute' ('Strawberry Fields Forever')
character: Warbly tape flute with a soft breathy attack, slight pitch wow and a hard 8-second tape cutoff. Lo-fi, mid-range.
recipe_steps: The sine-like ringout middle is the flute.
Unison +/-12 cents acts as tape wow.
No tape cutoff is needed: Sound Recorder's buffer end is the 8-second stop.

name: Emulator III Grand
inspired_by: E-mu Emulator III / Proteus 'Grand Piano' (90s 'pop piano')
character: A clean, bright, compressed piano with a hammer knock and a long decay. Not much body, but it cuts through a mix.
recipe_steps: chord.wav has a piano-ish attack: trim the very first click and keep the bloom.
XP Default's front is the hammer knock.
For the Korg house piano, see 'M1 Piano 16''.

name: Proteus 3 Ethnic Gamelan
inspired_by: E-mu Proteus/3 World 'Gamelan' and 'Bonang'
character: Metallic, slightly detuned pairs of struck bronze tones that beat against each other, with a long shimmering decay.
recipe_steps: The first strike of chimes gives the gong-chime partials.
Gamelan's paired-tuning shimmer is a wide unison: +/-22 cents.
An octave-up copy adds the bonang ring.
[planned pan] voice pairs hard L/R so the beating rotates.

name: Emulator Orchestra Hit
inspired_by: Fairlight CMI ORCH5 (Stravinsky Firebird) via the E-mu Emulator and every ROM after it
character: THE stab: a full-orchestra chord in one 300 ms hit. Huge transient, brassy mid, quick decay and lo-fi bite. Usually played in octaves.
recipe_steps: The first fanfare hit of tada.wav is already an orchestral stab: keep the first 25%.
++ for bite, E for the hall.
Play H0,12 (octaves), like 'Owner of a Lonely Heart' and Art of Noise.
critstop slowed an octave adds the low brass/timpani weight.
On 3.11, tada falls back to ding. There, use chimes<@15]++ as a thinner hit.

name: Fantasia
inspired_by: Roland D-50 preset 'Fantasia' (the most famous D-50 sound; Jean-Michel Jarre, 'Wonderful Life' era)
character: A bright, bell-like attack transient (a PCM 'chiff' plus a synth bell) layered on a soft, warm, chorused pad that swells in behind. Wide chorus, plenty of reverb. Sparkle on top, warmth below.
recipe_steps: Layer 1: the front of xpding, with an octave above, is the bell strike.
Layer 2: the middle of the XP Startup pad an octave down, U3 at +/-10 cents, is the warm chorused bed.
[planned env graph] layer 1 starts at 100% and decays in 900 ms; layer 2 rises over 600 ms and holds. That crossfade is the D-50 'LA' trick.
[planned pan] layer 2's unison voices at L50/C/R50 imitate the D-50 chorus.
[planned macro] M1 = bell vs pad balance.

name: Digital Native Dance
inspired_by: Roland D-50 'Digital Native Dance' (looped PCM percussion pad)
character: A rhythmic, looping PCM transient pattern (a kind of 'tick-tock' tribal motion) running under a sustained pad. The motion comes from the loop itself, with no LFO.
recipe_steps: Layer 1: build a rhythmic loop by doubling start.wav four times with @0CP (16 repeats), plus echo for syncopation. F keeps it at fixed tempo.
Layer 2: the logon pad, slowed, for the harmonic bed.
Variation: mix a crumple grain into the loop: start>@0CP@0CPMrecycle@0CP@0CP.
[planned offsets] start a second loop recorder 1/3 of the click period late for polyrhythm.

name: Staccato Heaven
inspired_by: Roland D-50 'Staccato Heaven' (bright staccato chime-pad)
character: Short glassy staccato chime attacks on every note, over a shimmering airy sustain. Strongly 'synth-pop heaven': bright, chorused, reverberant.
recipe_steps: chimes at x2, front 20%, echoed: a glass staccato.
The airy tail of logon as the heavenly sustain.
[planned env graph] fast decay on layer 1, slow rise on layer 2.

name: D-50 Pizzagogo
inspired_by: Roland D-50 'Pizzagogo' (pizzicato-plus-bell)
character: Plucky pizzicato with a bell overtone. Very short, bouncy, made for ostinatos.
recipe_steps: The front of xpringin is the pluck; the octave-up xpding front is the bell overtone.

name: D-50 Breathy Chiffer
inspired_by: Roland D-50 'Breathy Chiffer' (pan-flute-ish)
character: A breathy noise chiff into a pure tone with gentle vibrato; ethereal, 'new age'.
recipe_steps: The ringout middle is the tone; the start of the minimize whoosh is the chiff.

name: U-20 Piano/Strings
inspired_by: Roland U-20 / U-220 'Piano & Strings' split-layer combis (early-90s rompler)
character: A bright 'RS-PCM' piano attack layered with a lush slow string pad. Thin, clean and very early-90s ballad.
recipe_steps: chord.wav bloom for the piano; mid-logoff for the strings with a slow attack (planned env on layer 2 only).

name: JV-1080 Velo Strings
inspired_by: Roland JV-1080/2080 strings ('Velo Strings', 'Symphonic Str') plus SR-JV80-02 Orchestral
character: Big, smooth, high-res string section: a slow attack, a wide stereo hall and an ensemble shimmer. Bright when played hard.
recipe_steps: logoff and shutdown both have soft string-like shimmer; their attack transients are deleted.
[planned env graph] attack time follows velocity, and M1 ('expression') scales volume.

name: JV Pulse Arp
inspired_by: Roland JV-1080 'Pulse Pad'/'Ambient' sequenced presets and the XP-50 'Arp' patches
character: A tight, gated, ticking pad, a pulsing 16th-note motion baked into one held note.
recipe_steps: Cut a short chunk of logon and paste-insert copies of it: the seam at each copy boundary gives a rhythmic 'gate' pulse.
A click layer marks the beats.
[planned env graph] draw a gate shape (steps).

name: Sound Canvas Fantasia/Halo
inspired_by: Roland SC-55 GM 'Fantasia' (program 89 'Pad 1 New Age') and 'Halo Pad'
character: The GM-sized Fantasia: thinner and grainier than the D-50 original. Instantly recognizable 'MIDI file' nostalgia.
recipe_steps: Same idea as Fantasia, with a smaller unison and a shorter release: GM ROM economy is part of the charm.

name: SC-55 Choir Aahs
inspired_by: Roland Sound Canvas GM 53 'Choir Aahs' (and every GM module since)
character: A soft, slightly nasal 'aah' section with a 200 to 400 ms swell, a little vibrato and a gentle loop. Low top end.
recipe_steps: Slowed notify and xpnotify give vowel-like mid-range tones; unison makes the choir.
[planned env graph] a slight dip at 400 ms gives the GM loop-point feel.

name: SC-55 Voice Oohs
inspired_by: Roland Sound Canvas GM 54 'Voice Oohs'
character: A rounder, darker, almost-sine 'ooh' with a slower onset than Aahs. Breathy and intimate.
recipe_steps: ringout gives a sine-ish 'oo'; a whisper of crumple adds breath.

name: SC-55 Square Lead / GM Ocarina
inspired_by: Roland Sound Canvas GM 81 'Square Lead' and GM 80 'Ocarina'
character: Pure hollow square/sine lead with instant attack: 'video game MIDI' melody voice.
recipe_steps: Grab a tiny steady chunk of XP Battery Low, multiply it with @0CP into a sustained tone, then +++ clip it square.

name: MT-32 Fantasy Bell
inspired_by: Roland MT-32 / CM-32L 'Fantasy' & game-music bells (Sierra, LucasArts soundtracks)
character: Crunchy LA-synthesis bell with a PCM attack. 15-bit grit, a short reverb tail and a slightly aliased top.
recipe_steps: The >< round trip decimates (drops every other sample, then doubles), for MT-32-ish aliasing at the same pitch. Verify in reference mode.
Layer chimes and ding for the PCM 'ting'.

name: MT-32 Slap Bass
inspired_by: Roland MT-32 'SlapBass 1' (Monkey Island, King's Quest)
character: A thumb-slap transient into a short, buzzy, nasal bass. Unmistakably DOS-game.
recipe_steps: The XP Error tone, slowed and clipped, gives the buzzy bass; start.wav slowed down is the slap click.

name: XV Supersaw Pad
inspired_by: Roland XV-5080 / JP-8000 'Supersaw' trance pad and lead (late-90s trance)
character: Seven detuned saws: a bright buzzy spectrum, a wide stereo and a constantly beating chorus motion.
recipe_steps: Make a looped steady tone from chord.wav (@0CP doubling), clip it with ++ toward a saw-like buzz.
U8~35 gives eight unison voices over +/-35 cents. That beating IS the supersaw.
[planned pan] alternate unison voices L/R across the field.

name: JD-800 Glass Voices
inspired_by: Roland JD-800/JD-990 'Glass Voices' and 'Digital Native' style PCM-choir pads
character: A high, glassy choir with a crystalline top and slow evolving shimmer. 90s 'digital heaven'.
recipe_steps: Reversed chimes at x2 for a crystalline glass swell, over the notify choir.

name: Alpha Juno 'Hoover'
inspired_by: Roland Alpha Juno 2 'What The' / the Hoover (Joey Beltram 'Mentasm', 1991)
character: A huge, detuned, pulse-width-modulated, chorused buzz with a downward pitch swoop. Aggressive and seasick.
recipe_steps: A looped error tone, hard-clipped for the buzz.
B12 so the pitch bend gives the swoop. Without automation, pre-bake the swoop by adding a reversed 'restore' whoosh layer.

name: M1 Piano 16'
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Piano 16'' (house piano: Robin S, Crystal Waters, Black Box, 90s house)
character: A bright, clangy, mid-forward piano, layered with an octave so the chord stabs ring. The decay is fast. It is compressed, almost metallic, and made to stab offbeats.
recipe_steps: chord.wav (it already sounds like a struck chord) with the click trimmed; H0,12 adds the 16' octave doubling.
A bit of xpding for metallic clang.
Play chords: each note gives 2 voices, so the 16-recorder pool allows ~5-note chords per layer split. Recommend #10/#6.

name: M1 Organ 2
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Organ 2' (Robin S 'Show Me Love', 1993: the most famous rompler organ)
character: A percussive organ 'bark': a sharp, pitched click attack, then a short, round, hollow tone that decays to a low sustain. Played as a syncopated bass riff.
recipe_steps: Make a sustained sine-ish organ tone from a steady ringout chunk doubled with @0CP.
The x2 start.wav click is the key-click percussion.
[planned env graph] 220 ms drop to 35%: that decay IS the M1 Organ 2 bark.

name: M1 Universe
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Universe' (space pad: glassy bells over a wide airy pad)
character: A huge, slowly evolving space pad: a soft digital bell attack, a glassy upper partial band and a long, wide stereo tail.
recipe_steps: Slowed XP Startup without its intro is the evolving universe wash.
Reversed, sped-up chimes shimmer in on every note.
[planned pan] wide; [planned macro] M1 = shimmer level.

name: M1 Fretless
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Fretless' bass (90s pop/R&B)
character: A smooth, singing fretless bass: round, sine-heavy, with a gentle 'mwah' attack. Sustained.
recipe_steps: Two-octave-down ringout chunk = sine bass, XP Default front for the finger 'mwah'.

name: M1 Lore / Choir
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Lore' and 'Choir' (PCM choir, ambient 90s)
character: A breathy digital choir with a long reverb and a slightly hollow loop. Ethereal.
recipe_steps: A reversed slowed notify gives the 'breath-in' swell, with a forward notify for body.

name: Wavestation Glass Pad
inspired_by: Korg Wavestation 'Glass Mountain'/'Spectrum' vector pads (Wave Sequencing)
character: A pad that never sits still: short PCM fragments crossfade in sequence, making a rhythmic, shimmering, glassy motion inside one held note.
recipe_steps: Wave sequencing = Insert File chain: chimes, then xpding, then chimes x2, then print, all spliced in one buffer.
The logon pad underneath is the vector-blend bed.
[planned macro] M1/M2 = vector X/Y: crossfade 4 recorder layers (A/B/C/D) with the planned non-baked volume.

name: Wavestation 'Ocean Bed'
inspired_by: Korg Wavestation noise/ambient vector pads
character: A slow-moving, filtered-noise wash that sounds like breaking surf, with tonal glints.
recipe_steps: Crumple at -3 octaves sounds like surf; minimize/restore whooshes slowed and reversed are swells; a soft tone gives pitch.

name: Triton Pop Piano / Strings
inspired_by: Korg Triton 'Dance Piano' and 'Str Ensemble' (Y2K pop and R&B)
character: A crisp, glossy, stereo piano with a modern bright sheen, often layered with a soft string pad. Very Y2K TRL.
recipe_steps: Like M1 Piano 16', but with a slight unison and a string pad underneath.

name: Triton Hip-Hop Pluck
inspired_by: Korg Triton 'Pluck'/'Koto' & pizzicato presets (2000s hip-hop: Timbaland, Swizz Beatz)
character: A dry, short, exotic-sounding pluck (koto- or harp-like) with a clean digital attack, cutting through a sparse beat.
recipe_steps: The front of the XP Ringin marimba phrase is the dry pluck.
[planned offsets] for a harp gliss feel, chain recorders 15 ms apart.

name: Korg M1 Bell / 'Pole'
inspired_by: Korg M1 'Bell'/'Tines' family and Triton 'Pole Bells'
character: A pure, bright bell attack with a long, singing decay. Classic 90s ballad sparkle.
recipe_steps: xpding up an octave rings like a pole bell; the chimes front adds the clang.

name: DX7 E.PIANO 1
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 ROM1A 'E.PIANO 1' (the most used preset of the 80s: Whitney, Lionel Richie, every ballad)
character: A glassy FM 'tine' attack transient, with a sharp metallic bell harmonic, over a pure sine-like body. Hard playing brings out more bell. Long, clean decay, mild chorus, no real hammer noise.
recipe_steps: Layer 1: the xpding front with two octaves up (H0,24) is the metallic tine bell.
Layer 2: a sine-ish ringout chunk is the body.
Velocity matters: [planned macro] M1 tied to velocity adds layer-1 level (bell on hard hits).
[planned pan] 2 recorders per note with +/-6 cents and L30/R30 for the classic chorus.

name: DX7 BASS 1 / Solid Bass
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 'BASS 1' / 'SOLID BASS' (80s FM bass: a-ha, Kenny Loggins)
character: A snappy FM pluck with a percussive 'thwack' of upper harmonics. They decay in 100 ms, leaving a round, solid low tone.
recipe_steps: The XP Error low tone two octaves down is the body; a very short xpding front, slowed, is the FM 'thwack'.

name: DX7 TUB BELLS
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 'TUB BELLS' and 'E.BELL'/'GLOCKEN' (inharmonic FM bells)
character: Inharmonic metallic partials, a strong strike and a very long, slowly beating decay. Cold and crystalline.
recipe_steps: chimes and ding have real inharmonic bell spectra; a wide unison gives the FM beating.
Try EE> after the chimes trim for an extra metallic comb ring.

name: DX7 Koto
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 ROM 'KOTO' (80s 'exotic' pluck, also Emulator 'Koto')
character: A twangy, bright pluck with a fast pitch-drop 'ping', then a short nasal decay with metallic string buzz.
recipe_steps: Echo then speed-up makes a short comb: the koto's buzzing 'sawari' resonance.
Play pentatonic (In scale) for the trope.

name: TX81Z Lately Bass
inspired_by: Yamaha TX81Z preset 'LatelyBass' (Stevie Wonder 'Lately'; 90s house and R&B, everywhere)
character: A punchy FM bass. A bright, squelchy, rubbery attack drops fast into a hollow, nasal, slightly woody tone. The attack has a 'pluck', like a filter blip.
recipe_steps: Clipped XP Error an octave down is the hollow tone.
The front of Hardware Insert (a rising 'bloop'), slowed, gives the rubbery squelch on the attack.
[planned env graph] 250 ms decay to 40%, a quick 70 ms release.

name: TX81Z / FB-01 'Wood Piano'
inspired_by: Yamaha TX81Z/FB-01 'WoodPiano' & 4-op keys (DOS game and 90s budget-studio sound)
character: A dull, woody, bell-tinged 4-op keyboard: thin, but warm and nostalgic.
recipe_steps: XP Default's mallet; a touch of xpnotify.

name: SY77 / SY99 'Pacific Rim'
inspired_by: Yamaha SY77/SY99 AFM+AWM pads and 'Pacific Rim'-style breathy pads
character: A digital FM shimmer layered over sampled breath: wide, modern-1990, almost choral.
recipe_steps: Logon pad, reversed glass, and slowed crumple air.

name: DX7 Harmonica / Flute 1
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 'HARMONICA' and 'FLUTE 1' (FM wind with vibrato)
character: A reedy, slightly buzzy FM tone with a breathy onset and natural vibrato motion.
recipe_steps: A steady chunk of XP Battery Critical (a sine-ish alert), looped and lightly clipped, gives the reed.

name: Motif/Montage 'Full Grand' sparkle
inspired_by: Yamaha Motif 'Full Concert Grand' (2000s workstation piano)
character: A wide, glossy, modern stereo piano: clear attack, long bloom.
recipe_steps: Same base as M1 Piano, but a slower decay and less clang.

name: DX7 'Rhodes + Strings' ballad
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 E.PIANO layered with strings (the 80s power ballad combination)
character: An FM EP strike with a soft string wash fading in behind it.
recipe_steps: E.PIANO 1 plus a mid-logoff string bed. [planned env graph] the string layer rises slowly.

name: Mirage Grit Piano
inspired_by: Ensoniq Mirage (8-bit sampler, 1984) factory piano and strings
character: Low-res, aliased, noisy-but-musical samples, with a resonant analog filter and short loops. Charming crunch.
recipe_steps: Repeated >< decimation round trips (hypothesis: naive sample-dropping) for 8-bit/low-rate grit.
The 3.11 edition's native 8-bit 11 kHz WAVs (chimes/ding) are already Mirage-grade.

name: ESQ-1 Digital Pad
inspired_by: Ensoniq ESQ-1 / SQ-80 'Digital waves' pads (hybrid digital waves through analog filter)
character: Thin-edged digital waves, warmed by detune. The movement comes from wave crossfades. Metallic but cozy.
recipe_steps: A looped notify chunk is the 'digital wave'; detune warms it; a chimes ping on each attack.

name: VFX 'Digital Piano'/'Ice'
inspired_by: Ensoniq VFX/SD-1 'Transwaves' presets ('Ice' and glassy evolving waves)
character: Transwave scanning: the timbre sweeps across a set of waveforms during the note, a glassy morph from dull to bright.
recipe_steps: A transwave approximated as a time-ordered splice from dull (ringout) to bright (x2 print) with Insert File.
Because it plays through, the timbre 'scans' over the note.

name: Kurzweil K2000 'Hollow Pad'/'Pad Glass'
inspired_by: Kurzweil K2000/K2500 VAST pads (and the K250's famous 'Stereo Grand')
character: Deep, hollow, resonant pads with phasey, comb-like motion. Very 90s film and ambient.
recipe_steps: Mixing a copy of itself at a 3% offset (C@03X) gives a static comb: the VAST 'hollow' resonance.

name: Kurzweil K250 Stereo Grand
inspired_by: Kurzweil K250 (1984) 'Grand Piano', the first convincing sampled piano
character: A bright, punchy, fairly short-looped grand with a strong hammer.
recipe_steps: chord bloom plus a mallet knock.

name: Mirage 'Choir'
inspired_by: Ensoniq Mirage / EPS choir disks (Depeche Mode era)
character: A gritty, short-looped choir with an audible loop pulse. Melancholic 80s.
recipe_steps: Decimated slowed notify, chunk-looped so the loop pulse is audible: authentically Mirage.

name: EPS 'Orchestra Stab'
inspired_by: Ensoniq EPS / ASR-10 hip-hop stabs (90s boom bap)
character: A chopped, gritty orchestral stab with crate-digging dust.
recipe_steps: Orch hit with decimation and clip.

name: Absynth Evolving Atmosphere
inspired_by: NI Absynth factory atmospheres ('Aetherizer'-style granular, multi-segment envelope pads)
character: A pad that keeps changing for 10+ seconds: multi-segment envelopes, granular flicker, drifting pitch shimmer. Cinematic and alien.
recipe_steps: Four layers, each a different timescale: startup at -2 octaves (very slow wash), reversed logon (swells), reversed x4 chimes (glints), and slowed crumple (grain flicker).
[planned env graph] multi-segment, one per layer, at staggered peaks (2 s, 4 s, 7 s): the core of the Absynth feel.
[planned offsets] staggered recorder start times so the layers enter one after another.
[planned macro] M1 = 'evolution' (scales the env graph time).

name: Omnisphere Evolving Pad
inspired_by: Spectrasonics Omnisphere ('Analog Pad Dreams', 'Hardware Library', and the 'Coldplay pad' type)
character: A warm analog-ish pad core, a granular/texture layer moving over it, a slow filter breathing, a huge stereo and long tails.
recipe_steps: A warm core, a reversed swell and a slowed whoosh as the 'texture layer'.
[planned macro] M1 = texture amount, M2 = motion (detune spread).

name: Omnisphere 'Glass Harp'
inspired_by: Omnisphere glass/psaltery family and 'Crystal Pad' types
character: Plucked glass with ringing high partials and a soft bowed swell behind it.
recipe_steps: A sped-up xpding pluck, with a reversed sped-up chime swell behind it.

name: Alchemy 'Spectral' Pad
inspired_by: Apple/Camel Alchemy additive and spectral resynthesis pads
character: Smeared, frozen, resynthesized timbres: partials hang in time with a glassy, slightly phasey shimmer.
recipe_steps: A 'spectral freeze': take a short chunk, repeat it 16 times, then add echo to smear the seams.

name: Massive Growl/Reese
inspired_by: NI Massive (dubstep and DnB growls and reese basses)
character: A thick, detuned, distorted low buzz with a slow phasing motion; mono low end and gritty mids.
recipe_steps: A clipped looped tone at -2 octaves; U4~25 gives the slow phasing beat.

name: Serum Supersaw Pluck
inspired_by: Xfer Serum future-bass and EDM plucks ('Future Bass Chord', 'Pluck Basic')
character: A detuned saw stack with a fast filter-pluck envelope: bright attack, a 300 ms decay into a soft sustain, a wide stereo field.
recipe_steps: The supersaw core with a pluck envelope.
Future-bass chords: H0,4,7,11 (maj7) with #16. Each note eats 4 voices, so play one note.

name: Spire Trance Lead
inspired_by: Reveal Sound Spire (trance and big-room leads, 'Hypersaw')
character: A bright, wide, octave-stacked hypersaw lead that cuts and sings.
recipe_steps: The supersaw core plus an octave; pair it with an echo layer for the trance delay.

name: Sylenth Classic Trance Pluck
inspired_by: LennarDigital Sylenth1 ('Pluck' and 'Arp' factory presets, 2000s trance and progressive house)
character: A short, round-but-bright pluck with a hint of detune and a 1/8-dotted delay tail. Made for arps.
recipe_steps: Layer 2 uses <E> (slow down, echo, speed up) for a delay that is twice as long, at the original pitch.
[planned offsets] better: 3 recorders at 0 / 187 / 375 ms (dotted 1/8 at 120 bpm), at 100 / 50 / 25% volume, panned C/L/R.

name: Nexus 'Trance Pad'
inspired_by: reFX Nexus ROM ('Trance Pad', 'Hands Up' and 'Euro' supersaw pads)
character: A bright supersaw pad with a long release: euphoric, wall-of-sound.
recipe_steps: Supersaw core with a slow attack.

name: Zebra 'Dark Zebra' Cinematic
inspired_by: u-he Zebra2 / Dark Zebra (Hans Zimmer cinematic pads and drones)
character: A dark, low, ominous drone pad with a slow, grinding metallic motion.
recipe_steps: critstop at -2 octaves is a doom bed; a reversed slow shutdown swells; slowed crumple adds grinding texture.

name: Kontakt Factory 'Bowed Glass'
inspired_by: Kontakt factory 'Synth Pads' and bowed-glass/waterphone FX (2000s scoring)
character: Glass bowed into a slow, eerie swell with pitchy shimmer and dissonant partials.
recipe_steps: Reversed glassy chimes with echo smear and a wide detune for eeriness.

name: Kontakt Factory 'Music Box'
inspired_by: Kontakt factory 'Music Box' / celesta (and every lullaby in 2000s media)
character: A tiny tine pluck at a high register with a fast decay and a mechanical, slightly out-of-tune charm.
recipe_steps: xpding up an octave; slight detune.

name: Ethno World Duduk
inspired_by: Best Service Ethno World duduk (Gladiator-style; 2000s film)
character: A mournful, nasal, reedy double-reed tone with breath, a slow swell and expressive vibrato.
recipe_steps: A looped sine-ish alert tone, slowed for a lower nasal register, plus breath.

name: Ethno World Ethnic Vox
inspired_by: Ethno World / Ethno Vocal chants ('Ethnic female vox', 'Lisa Gerrard' style)
character: Wordless, exotic, melismatic vocal wail with a long reverb and melancholy.
recipe_steps: A low notify vocal formant with a reversed swell.

name: Omnisphere 'Pluck Box' Shimmer Arp
inspired_by: Omnisphere/Keyscape arpeggiated shimmer plucks
character: A soft bell pluck with a long reverse-reverb shimmer tail building between notes.
recipe_steps: RER = reverse, echo, reverse: a pre-echo/reverse-reverb that swells into the note.

name: Serum 'Granular Air' Pad
inspired_by: Serum/Vital noise-wavetable airy pads
character: Breathy, hissy air with a tonal center: wind through a tube, a modern 'airy' top.
recipe_steps: Slowed minimize/restore whooshes as air (fixed pitch), over a sine-ish tone.

name: 808 Sub Boom
inspired_by: Roland TR-808 kick-as-bass (trap and hip-hop 808, sub-bass category benchmark)
character: A nearly pure sine at 40 to 60 Hz with a short click, a pitch drop at the start and a long decay. All weight, no top.
recipe_steps: The slowed start.wav click is the 808 knock.

name: Reese Bass
inspired_by: Kevin Saunderson 'Just Want Another Chance' Reese (DnB/jungle benchmark)
character: Two detuned saws beating against each other: a slow, menacing phasing motion with mono weight and a hollow, buzzy mid.
recipe_steps: U2~18 = exactly two voices +/-18 cents: the classic two-saw beat.
A clipped looped tone is the saw.
Lower the cents for a slower roll.

name: FM Slap Bass
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7 'SLAP BASS' / Korg M1 'SlapBass' (80s funk pop)
character: A metallic, percussive pop transient into a short, bright, twangy bass with a fast decay.
recipe_steps: A clipped error front plus the start.wav click for the slap.

name: Moog-style Deep Sub
inspired_by: Minimoog / Model D bass (70s-80s funk, synth-pop)
character: A fat, round, warm low tone with a soft attack and a slight filter 'thump'.
recipe_steps: Error tone plus sine sub, lightly detuned.

name: Acid 303 Squelch
inspired_by: Roland TB-303 (acid house, benchmark squelch bass)
character: A resonant, rubbery, squelchy saw with an envelope-swept filter 'yow' and accents.
recipe_steps: Hardware Insert/Remove have rising/falling 'bloops' that act like a filter sweep; slowed and clipped they become the squelch.
[planned macro] M1 = crossfade between them (cutoff), M2 = clip (resonance feel).

name: Wobble Bass
inspired_by: Dubstep LFO wobble (Massive/Serum, 2009-2012)
character: A sub plus a mid growl whose filter/volume pulses rhythmically (1/4 to 1/16 note).
recipe_steps: [planned env graph] draw a looping volume graph at tempo (wub).

name: Lo-fi Upright Thump
inspired_by: Upright/acoustic bass in lo-fi hip-hop (sampled jazz bass)
character: A woody, muted, short thump with a round low and finger noise.
recipe_steps: XP Default at -2 octaves is a woody body.

name: Pluck Bass (Synth-pop)
inspired_by: Juno-106 / SH-101 plucked bass (synthwave and 80s synth-pop)
character: A short, bright, filter-plucked bass. Eighth-note sequencer staple.
recipe_steps: A looped clipped alert tone at -2 octaves with a short decay.

name: Korg M1 'House Bass' / Organ Bass
inspired_by: Korg M1 organ bass and 90s house bass presets
character: A rounded, slightly clicky, sine-plus-octave bass that bounces.
recipe_steps: The M1 Organ 2 recipe, two octaves down.

name: Critical Doom Sub
inspired_by: Cinematic sub-drop / 'braam' low end (Inception-era trailers)
character: A colossal, slowly growing low brass-bass blast with grit.
recipe_steps: critstop at -3 octaves is the braam; clip it for snarl.

name: Rhodes Mk I Suitcase
inspired_by: Fender Rhodes (Stevie Wonder, neo-soul, lo-fi: the EP benchmark)
character: A bell-like tine attack with a warm, sine-ish body, a long sustain, a bark when played hard and a stereo tremolo.
recipe_steps: [planned pan] tremolo = per-recorder pan alternation driven by M1.

name: Wurlitzer 200A
inspired_by: Wurlitzer electric piano (Supertramp, Ray Charles, indie)
character: A reedy, nasal, slightly overdriven bark, shorter and edgier than a Rhodes, with tremolo.
recipe_steps: A clipped mallet with a reedy looped alert tone.

name: Tonewheel Drawbar Organ
inspired_by: Hammond B3 (+ Leslie): the organ benchmark
character: Additive sine drawbars, a key-click, percussion and a Leslie swirl (doppler and amp motion).
recipe_steps: Looped sine chunk; drawbars via H0,12,19,24 (8', 4', 2 2/3', 2').
[planned pan] slow L/R alternation for the rotor.

name: Gospel Organ 'Full'
inspired_by: Hammond full-drawbar gospel/rock organ
character: Every drawbar out, overdriven, Leslie fast: a thick, gritty roar.

name: Clavinet D6 Funk
inspired_by: Hohner Clavinet ('Superstition': the clav benchmark)
character: A bright, percussive, plucked-string bite with a quick decay and a nasal 'wah' honk. Very funky, very short.
recipe_steps: A pluck front, clipped, with an EE> comb for the string nasality.

name: FM EP 'DX Tine' (90s)
inspired_by: Yamaha DX7II 'Full Tines' / Korg M1 'E.Piano' (90s R&B)
character: A softer FM EP: rounder bell, more chorus, a lush ballad tone.
recipe_steps: E.PIANO 1, but less high bell, more chorus.

name: Harpsichord
inspired_by: Harpsichord (baroque; also M1/JV 'Harpsi' presets)
character: A bright, buzzy, jangly pluck with a sharp attack and a metallic sheen. No dynamics.
recipe_steps: A comb ring from echo then speed-up gives the jangle; V0 for no dynamics.

name: Toy Piano / Celesta
inspired_by: Celesta and toy piano (Danny Elfman, Y2K whimsy)
character: A tiny bell-hammer pluck, very high and sweet, with a short metallic ping.

name: Vaporwave EP (slowed DX)
inspired_by: DX7 EP slowed and drenched (Macintosh Plus 'リサフランク420' sound)
character: A woozy, pitched-down electric piano: smeared transients, washed-out reverb, thick and dreamy.
recipe_steps: Two octaves down with echo between each slow-down: the echoes grow longer and blurrier.

name: Pipe/Church Organ
inspired_by: Pipe organ (cathedral full organ)
character: Stacked flue pipes, slow 'speak' onset, an immense reverb. Awe.
recipe_steps: Octave stacking plus echo for the cathedral.

name: Trance Pluck
inspired_by: Classic trance pluck (Sylenth 'Pluck' / Nexus 'Pluck' / Gaia-style)
character: A clean bright pluck with a 150 ms decay, a wide stereo and an echo tail. It arpeggiates beautifully.
recipe_steps: Layer 2 uses <<E>> for an echo 4x longer at the original pitch.
[planned offsets] true tempo delay: 3 recorders 0/250/500 ms.

name: Bubble Arp
inspired_by: Aero 'bubble' arps (MSN-era, Frutiger Aero aesthetic) / Massive 'Bubbles'
character: Round 'bloop' plucks with an upward pitch flick. Wet, playful and watery.
recipe_steps: XP Balloon (a soft pop) is the source of all Aero bubbles.

name: Marimba Arp
inspired_by: Marimba/kalimba arpeggios (Nexus, Steve Reich, 2000s ringtones)
character: A woody mallet pluck with a fast decay and a warm resonator.
recipe_steps: XP Default and the XP Ringin front.

name: Harp Gliss
inspired_by: Concert harp (JV-1080 'Harp', Proteus/2 harp)
character: A soft, round pluck that rings long; glissandi are the iconic gesture.
recipe_steps: [planned offsets] strum: a chord voiced across 6 recorders with offsets 0/20/40/60/80/100 ms is the gliss.

name: Guitar-ish Nylon Pluck
inspired_by: GM 25 'Nylon Guitar' / JV 'Nylon Gtr'
character: A soft thumb pluck: warm mids, short body.

name: Pizzicato Ostinato
inspired_by: Proteus/JV 'Pizzicato' (90s scoring ostinatos)
character: A short, bouncy string pluck.

name: Glass Pluck Delay
inspired_by: Modern 'glass pluck' (Future garage, chillstep)
character: A crystalline, very bright pluck with ping-pong echoes.
recipe_steps: Chimes at x4 front, plus a long echo copy.

name: 8-bit Chiptune Arp
inspired_by: NES/Game Boy pulse arps (chiptune, Y2K Flash games)
character: A buzzy pulse wave, rapid arpeggios, no reverb, instant attack and release.
recipe_steps: A looped clipped alert tone gives the pulse.

name: Warm Analog Pad
inspired_by: Oberheim OB-X / Juno-60 strings-pad (warm pad benchmark)
character: A detuned saw/pulse pad with a slow attack, a filter softness, chorus and a long release. Warm, soft-focus.
recipe_steps: XP Startup's middle plus logoff, both slowed: the warmest Windows audio.

name: Glass Pad
inspired_by: Glass/crystal pads (Wavestation, JD-800, Nexus 'Glass')
character: Bright, cold, high-partial shimmer with a soft attack and glittery motion.

name: Evolving Motion Pad
inspired_by: Wavestation/Omnisphere-style motion pads
character: Timbre and rhythm change over the length of the note.
recipe_steps: A spliced sequence with echo smearing; the note plays through the splice for movement.

name: Choir Pad
inspired_by: Choir pads (M1 'Choir', JV 'Vox Pad', Omnisphere 'Choir Pad')
character: A breathy vowel 'aah' blended with synth pad.

name: Swell Pad (Reverse)
inspired_by: Reverse-reverb swells (shoegaze, ambient)
character: Sound grows out of silence into the note, then cuts. Sucking, hypnotic.
recipe_steps: Reverse plus echo: the 'swell pad' idiom.
The env attack can stay short: the swell is baked in.

name: Strings Machine Pad
inspired_by: ARP Solina / Logan String Melody (Jarre, Joy Division)
character: A buzzy, ensemble-chorused string synth pad with heavy triple-chorus motion. Thin, but iconic.
recipe_steps: A looped chunk with U4~22 for the ensemble effect.

name: Dark Ambient Pad
inspired_by: Dark ambient (Brian Eno 'Music for Airports' / Biosphere)
character: Deep, slow, slightly unstable tones. Long fades, very little high end.

name: Shimmer Pad
inspired_by: Shimmer reverb pads (Eventide 'Shimmer', U2/The Edge, ambient guitar)
character: Octave-up reverb cascade: the note grows a sparkling halo an octave and two octaves above.
recipe_steps: Layers at +12 and +24 baked by speed-up with echo between, so the higher echoes cascade.

name: Sweep Pad
inspired_by: Filter-sweep pads (Prophet-5, trance breakdowns)
character: A pad whose brightness slowly opens and closes.
recipe_steps: Whoosh layers give a noise-band sweep.
[planned macro] M1 = 'cutoff', crossfading a dull layer (<<) into a bright layer (>).

name: PWM Pad
inspired_by: Juno-106 PWM pad
character: A hollow pulse with a slow pulse-width modulation: a constant, gentle chorus warble.
recipe_steps: A clipped pulse loop; unison beat simulates the PWM.

name: Mellotron Choir
inspired_by: Mellotron M400 '8-Voice Choir' (Bowie 'Space Oddity', Genesis, King Crimson, Radiohead)
character: A haunting, dusty tape choir with a slow onset, wow and flutter, a mid-focused 'ah' and an 8-second tape length. Eerie, melancholy, unrealistic in the best way.
recipe_steps: notify at -2 octaves, slightly quieter, gives the low choir formant.
Slowed crumple is the tape hiss.
The natural buffer end (no loop) is the tape stop, authentically Mellotron.

name: GM Choir Aahs
inspired_by: GM 53 'Choir Aahs' (SC-55/88, every MIDI file)
character: See 'SC-55 Choir Aahs'.
recipe_steps: Same as 'SC-55 Choir Aahs'; a duplicate entry in the category list.

name: Fairlight 'Arr1' Choir Hit
inspired_by: Fairlight CMI ARR1 (Kate Bush, Tears for Fears 'Mad World')
character: A short, breathy sampled 'aah' stab: lo-fi, dramatic, 80s.

name: Gregorian Monks
inspired_by: Male choir chant ('Enigma' 'Sadeness', 90s new age)
character: A low, sustained male unison 'oo' with a church reverb.
recipe_steps: Two octaves down, sine-ish, with an echo hall.

name: Ethereal Female 'Ooh'
inspired_by: Enya / Lisa Gerrard airy vocal pads (new age)
character: A high, breathy, floaty 'ooh' with a huge reverb.
recipe_steps: ringout up an octave, with air.

name: Vox Chop
inspired_by: Vocal chops (future bass, deep house)
character: A short, pitched vocal syllable, chopped and rhythmic.

name: Space Choir 'Aah' (Vangelis)
inspired_by: Yamaha CS-80 + choir / Vangelis 'Blade Runner' vox
character: A huge, slow, brassy-vocal pad with a big reverb.

name: Glassy Speed Bell
inspired_by: Glassy FM bell (DX7 'E.BELL', M1 'Bell', 'glass bell' trope)
character: Pure, bright, inharmonic shimmer: an instant strike and a long ringing decay, stacked an octave and a fifth for sparkle.
recipe_steps: Speed x2 twice on chimes for the glassy bell.
3 harmony voices at the root, octave and octave+fifth.
[planned env graph] a slow-attack version for a 'bowed' glass bell.

name: Vibraphone
inspired_by: Vibraphone (jazz, ambient; JV 'Vibes')
character: A soft mallet onto a sine-like bar, with a long ring and motor tremolo.
recipe_steps: A mallet plus a sine tail.
[planned macro] M1 = tremolo depth via volume automation.

name: Glockenspiel
inspired_by: Glockenspiel (film whimsy, GM 10)
character: A very bright, high, metallic strike with a short ring.

name: Tubular Bells
inspired_by: Tubular bells (Mike Oldfield; orchestral chimes)
character: A heavy strike with deep inharmonic partials and a long decay.

name: Marimba
inspired_by: Marimba (GM 13; Reich)
character: A woody mallet with a short resonant decay and warm low partials.

name: Steel Gamelan Bell
inspired_by: Balinese gamelan bell / gong (Proteus World)
character: Paired-detune shimmer: metallic, long.

name: Music Box
inspired_by: Cylinder music box (lullaby trope)
character: A tiny tine with a mechanical pluck, high register and a slightly sour tuning.

name: Crystal Bowl / Singing Glass
inspired_by: Singing bowls (wellness, ambient)
character: A soft rub onset, then a pure, beating, endlessly sustained tone.
recipe_steps: The ring tail of ding, looped.

name: String Ensemble (Lush)
inspired_by: JV-1080 'Velo Strings' / Proteus/2 'Strings' (the 90s lush section)
character: Slow attack, warm mids, ensemble shimmer, wide hall.

name: Staccato Strings
inspired_by: Short staccato strings (spiccato, scoring ostinatos)
character: A short bowed bite, 150 ms, a woody room.
recipe_steps: A short logoff chunk with a bow-noise tick.

name: Tremolo Strings
inspired_by: Tremolo strings (horror and suspense)
character: Rapid bow repetition: shivering motion.
recipe_steps: A tiny chunk repeated 32x: the paste seams give a fast re-bow tremolo.

name: Solo Cello
inspired_by: Solo cello (Ethno World, Kontakt)
character: A rich, woody, nasal low bowed tone with vibrato.

name: Synth Strings 1 (GM 51)
inspired_by: GM 'SynthStrings 1' (SC-55, every 90s MIDI)
character: A slightly brassy, buzzy synth string with a soft attack.

name: Disco Strings Rise
inspired_by: Disco string runs (Salsoul, French house samples)
character: A bright, glossy section with an upward sweep before the hit.
recipe_steps: The restore whoosh up gives the rise.

name: Orchestra Hit
inspired_by: Fairlight ORCH5 / Emulator orch hit (Art of Noise, Yes, 'Owner of a Lonely Heart'; everywhere since)
character: See 'Emulator Orchestra Hit': a full chord in one transient.

name: Brass Stab (Jump)
inspired_by: Oberheim OB-Xa brass stab (Van Halen 'Jump') / Prophet brass
character: A bright, punchy, detuned saw brass chord with a quick 'blat' attack.
recipe_steps: A looped tada chunk, clipped and detuned, gives the synth brass.

name: Synth Brass Pad (Vangelis)
inspired_by: Yamaha CS-80 brass (Vangelis 'Chariots of Fire')
character: A slow, swelling, warm brass pad with expressive brightness.
recipe_steps: tada slowed into a warm brass bed.

name: Real Horn Section Stab
inspired_by: Horn stab (JV/Proteus 'Brass Section', funk/soul)
character: A tight 3-horn 'baap' with a brassy rip and a fast decay.

name: French Horns (Epic)
inspired_by: Epic horn swell (Hans Zimmer, trailer)
character: Massed, round, dark horns with a slow crescendo.

name: Rave Stab
inspired_by: Rave/hardcore stab (Korg M1 'Organ 2'/Mentasm/Orch hits)
character: A short, loud, chordal, minor stab with grit.

name: Supersaw Lead
inspired_by: Roland JP-8000 supersaw (trance benchmark)
character: See 'XV Supersaw Pad', with a shorter attack and an octave.

name: Sync Lead
inspired_by: Oscillator-sync lead (Cars 'Let's Go', Prophet-5)
character: A tearing, vocal, metallic lead with a sweeping formant.
recipe_steps: A looped bloop chunk, clipped: the rising formant reads as 'sync'.

name: Square Lead (Chip / GM 81)
inspired_by: GM Square Lead / pulse leads
character: A hollow square: video-game melody.

name: Sine Whistle Lead
inspired_by: Moog/Theremin-ish sine lead (G-funk whistle: Dr. Dre)
character: A pure, high, singing sine with portamento and vibrato.
recipe_steps: A sine-ish ringout up an octave.

name: Mono Saw Lead (Minimoog)
inspired_by: Minimoog lead (Jan Hammer, prog)
character: A fat, slightly detuned, warm saw lead.
recipe_steps: The saw core, mono feel, small detune.

name: Pan-Flute Lead (Zamfir)
inspired_by: Pan flute lead (see world)
character: See 'Pan Flute'.

name: Distorted Hoover Lead
inspired_by: Hoover as lead (gabber and rave)
character: See 'Alpha Juno Hoover'.

name: Koto
inspired_by: Koto (DX7, Emulator, Proteus World)
character: See 'DX7 Koto': a twang with a pitch drop and a buzzing resonance.

name: Shakuhachi
inspired_by: Shakuhachi (E-II 'Sledgehammer', Fairlight, Proteus World)
character: See 'Shakuhachi Hammer'.

name: Sitar
inspired_by: Sitar (Ravi Shankar; 60s psych; Proteus World 'Sitar')
character: A bright, buzzy, sweeping 'jawari' resonance, sympathetic string drones and a nasal twang.
recipe_steps: The EEE>> comb gives the jawari buzz.
A reversed copy is the sympathetic-string swell.
The sine drone layer underneath is the tanpura.

name: Kalimba
inspired_by: Kalimba / mbira (Proteus World, Alchemy, Earth Wind & Fire)
character: See 'Proteus World Kalimba'.

name: Pan Flute
inspired_by: Pan flute (Zamfir; GM 76; Korg M1 'PanFlute')
character: A breathy, hollow, airy tone with a strong 'chiff' and gentle vibrato. Very 90s 'relaxing'.
recipe_steps: A sine-ish body plus a whoosh chiff.
[planned env graph] a small overshoot at 60 ms for the chiff.

name: Steel Drum
inspired_by: Steel drum / steelpan (GM 115; Proteus World; tropical house)
character: A bright, metallic, round strike with characteristic inharmonic 'boing' partials and a medium decay. Happy and tropical.
recipe_steps: The xpding strike's EE> comb gives the 'pan' ring.
XP Default's mallet gives the round body.

name: Ocarina
inspired_by: Ocarina (Zelda; GM 80)
character: A pure, round, hollow tone with a breathy onset.

name: Tabla / Hand Drums
inspired_by: Tabla/hand percussion (Ethno World; Proteus World)
character: A pitched drum 'dha' with a resonant bend and a dry slap.
recipe_steps: A slowed mallet plus a slap click.

name: Erhu
inspired_by: Erhu (Chinese fiddle; Ethno World)
character: A nasal, expressive, sliding bowed tone.
recipe_steps: A looped nasal tone with a wide bend.

name: Didgeridoo
inspired_by: Didgeridoo (Ethno World, ambient)
character: A low, growling, rhythmic formant drone.
recipe_steps: A looped low error tone with echo.

name: Tanpura Drone
inspired_by: Tanpura (Indian classical drone)
character: Constantly shimmering overtones on a fixed root and fifth.
recipe_steps: A looped sine tone, root/fifth/octave, plus echo shimmer.

name: Deep Space Drone
inspired_by: Ambient space drone (Stars of the Lid, Brian Eno)
character: Very slow, dense, dark, gently beating tones.

name: Machine Hum Drone
inspired_by: Industrial hum (server room, 50/60 Hz)
character: Steady, buzzy low hum with harmonic grit.
recipe_steps: A clipped looped tone, low, fixed.

name: Eerie Bowed Metal
inspired_by: Bowed cymbal / waterphone (horror)
character: A metallic, dissonant, screeching sustain.
recipe_steps: Reversed, slowed chimes with echo; wide detune for dissonance.

name: Organ Drone (Cathedral)
inspired_by: Church organ drone (Arvo Part, ambient)
character: A pure, immovable stack.

name: White Noise Riser
inspired_by: EDM noise riser/sweep (Nexus FX, Massive)
character: Noise rising in pitch and brightness over 4 to 8 bars.
recipe_steps: restore is an upward whoosh; reversed minimize also rises.
[planned env graph] a long exponential ramp.

name: Reverse Cymbal
inspired_by: Reverse cymbal swell (pop and hip-hop transitions)
character: A shimmering noise swell into the downbeat.

name: Downlifter / Impact
inspired_by: Downlifter and trailer impact (sub drop)
character: A big hit, then a falling noise and pitch tail.
recipe_steps: A low critstop hit plus a downward whoosh.

name: Laser Zap
inspired_by: Laser 'pew' (Y2K, retro FX)
character: A fast falling-pitch zap.
recipe_steps: The descending Hardware Remove at x4 speed.

name: Glitch Stutter
inspired_by: Glitch FX (Autechre, 2000s IDM; Massive 'Stutter')
character: Rapid-fire, chopped, repeating fragments.
recipe_steps: Repeat a tiny chunk with an Insert-File click inside the loop.

name: Sci-fi Computer Babble
inspired_by: Sci-fi computer bleeps (Star Trek, 70s/80s)
character: Random, rapid, pitched bleeps.
recipe_steps: Splice alert tones into a sequence of bleeps.

name: Underwater Bubbles
inspired_by: Bubble FX (Frutiger Aero aquariums; Massive 'Bubbles')
character: A random cascade of round 'blips' with a watery resonance.
recipe_steps: Splice balloon pops at varied speeds; echo for water.

name: Tape Stop
inspired_by: Tape stop/slowdown (vaporwave, hip-hop)
character: The sound grinds down in pitch to a halt.
recipe_steps: Can't glide pitch, so fake it as a cascade.
[planned offsets] 4 recorders at speed x1, /2, /4, /8 with offsets 0/150/300/450 ms and falling volume.

name: Vaporwave Slowed Pad
inspired_by: Vaporwave ('Floral Shoppe', 'Eccojams' slowed, reverbed)
character: Pitched down 30%-plus (here an octave), heavy reverb, smeared, thick and nostalgic. The pad is a corporate sound remembered half-asleep.
recipe_steps: Slow, then echo, then slow, then echo: each echo comes out longer and lower (the step order is the effect).

name: Mallsoft Atrium
inspired_by: Mallsoft (Disconscious, 'Hologram Plaza'; '猫 シ Corp')
character: Muzak in an empty mall: distant, reverberant, muffled and endless.
recipe_steps: Slowed crumple is the crowd/HVAC murmur.
[planned macro] M1 = distance (echo layer vs dry).

name: Eccojam Loop
inspired_by: Daniel Lopatin 'Eccojams' (looped slowed pop fragments)
character: A short phrase looped hypnotically, slowed and echoed.
recipe_steps: A chunk looped with @0CP and echoed, played at a fixed pitch.

name: Lo-fi Tape Keys
inspired_by: Lo-fi hip-hop keys (ChilledCow era)
character: A warm, wobbly, dusty EP with a soft attack and noise.
recipe_steps: A Rhodes recipe with decimation, wide wow and dust.

name: Bitcrushed Chiptune Pad
inspired_by: 8-bit lo-fi texture
character: Aliasing, quantization noise, stepped tone.
recipe_steps: A >>><<< round trip (decimate by 8) plus a ----++++ requantize (hypothesis: loses bits on 8-bit sources).

name: VHS Warble
inspired_by: VHS tape warble pads (synthwave, chillwave)
character: A wobbly pitch, a dull top and soft saturation.
recipe_steps: Wide unison for warble, decimation for the dull top.

name: Vinyl Crackle Bed
inspired_by: Lo-fi vinyl noise layer
character: Crackle and hiss as a texture under everything.
recipe_steps: Crumple chopped and looped into crackle.
Use it as a layer under keys.

name: Slowed + Reverb Chord
inspired_by: 'Slowed + reverb' YouTube edits (2017-2020)
character: A chord stab slowed into a vast dreamy wash.
recipe_steps: Interleave < and E so the echoes grow longer.

name: Aero Startup Swell
inspired_by: Windows XP/Vista startup sounds (Brian Eno 95 / XP / Vista 'Aero' startup)
character: A glossy, optimistic swell: a bright pad bloom, sparkle notes, a big airy reverb. Pure 2001-2009 'future'.
recipe_steps: XP Startup itself, playable chromatically, with a reversed glass shimmer.
This is the brand preset: the source sound IS the aesthetic.

name: Water Droplet Pluck
inspired_by: Frutiger Aero water drop (Vista/Windows 7 'notify', Apple 'Drip', 2000s UI)
character: A tiny round bloop with a rising pitch flick, very short, plus a watery resonance.
recipe_steps: The balloon front plus a short rising Hardware Insert bloop.

name: Bubbly Aero Arp
inspired_by: Frutiger Aero bubbles (MSN Messenger, 'Aqua' UI, Wii menus)
character: Bouncy, rounded, glossy plucks with soft echoes, like bubbles in an aquarium.

name: Glassy Aqua Pad
inspired_by: Frutiger Aero glassy pads (Vista 'Aurora', 2000s tech commercials)
character: Clean, bright, transparent pad with sparkly top, slow shimmer.
recipe_steps: Logon body with reversed bright sparkle layers.

name: Airy Breath Pad
inspired_by: Aero airy pads (Vista/Win7 'Windows Calendar' etc.)
character: Breathy air over a soft sine chord.

name: MSN Nudge Boing
inspired_by: MSN Messenger nudge/sign-in style blips (2000s chat)
character: A playful, rubbery boing with a quick pitch wobble.

name: Aero Keyboard Chime
inspired_by: Windows Vista / 7 chord chimes (Windows 7 'Windows Background', 'Notify')
character: A soft glassy chord pluck with a long gentle decay.
recipe_steps: XP Notify, voiced as an open chord.

name: Aquarium Ambience
inspired_by: Aero aquariums, screensavers ('Aquarium', 'Windows Media visualizations')
character: Water movement, bubbles and a soft pad: calm, glossy.
recipe_steps: Slowed crumple = water; balloon splice = bubbles; logon = calm pad.

name: Vista Sparkle Glissando
inspired_by: Vista 'Windows Startup' / iPod-era sparkles
character: A rising cascade of crystalline notes.
recipe_steps: [planned offsets] harmony H0,4,7,12 voices with 40 ms offsets each = an upward gliss.

name: Liquid Glass Bell
inspired_by: Aero-style glass bell (Apple 'Glass', 'Crystal' alert sounds)
character: A pure, bright, glassy single tone with a soft halo.
recipe_steps: The bell, with a reverse-reverb halo.

name: Corporate Logo Sting
inspired_by: 2000s corporate intro stings (Intel bong, PowerPoint templates, 'Microsoft Sound')
character: Three to five bright, confident notes, then a big shiny chord bloom with reverb. Sounds like 'innovation'.
recipe_steps: tada fanfare, chime sparkle, startup bloom.

name: Web Portal Click
inspired_by: 2000s web-portal UI clicks (Internet Explorer 'navigation start' click, Yahoo! / MSN portals)
character: A crisp, dry, pitched tick.
recipe_steps: start.wav: the actual IE navigation click.
Drop F for a pitched percussion kit.

name: Hold Music Muzak Keys
inspired_by: 2000s on-hold music / corporate training video (Kevin MacLeod-era stock)
character: Bland, bright, slightly chorused EP and strings: inoffensive, glossy.
recipe_steps: The DX EP plus strings combination, mixed polite.

name: Dial-up Handshake Texture
inspired_by: 56k modem handshake (Y2K internet)
character: Screeching tones, noise bursts and pitched beeps in a sequence.

name: Nokia-style Ringtone Lead
inspired_by: Early-2000s monophonic ringtones
character: A pure square-ish tone, staccato, high and cheerful.
recipe_steps: A looped clipped alert tone, up an octave.

name: Tech Presentation Pad
inspired_by: Corporate keynote background pads (2000s product launch)
character: A bright, optimistic, wide synth-pad bed with a gentle pulse.
recipe_steps: The logon pad with a quiet ticking clock layer.

name: Y2K Trance Gate
inspired_by: Y2K trance-gate pads (ATB '9PM', Darude)
character: A pad chopped into a 16th-note rhythmic gate.
recipe_steps: Seams of paste-insert copies give the rhythmic gate.

name: Windows Error Choir
inspired_by: Windows-error remixes (YouTube 'Windows sounds' meme music)
character: Error and critical sounds as playable instruments: comic and nostalgic.
recipe_steps: The source sounds as they are, layered and chromatically playable. That is the meme.

name: Flash Intro Whoosh-Hit
inspired_by: 2000s Flash website intros (whoosh, then bright hit)
character: A fast noise sweep, then a sparkly impact chord.
recipe_steps: [planned offsets] whoosh at 0 ms, hit at 250 ms.

name: CD-ROM Encyclopedia Pad
inspired_by: 90s/Y2K edutainment (Encarta, MS Plus! themes)
character: A gentle, clean, wondering digital pad with bell plinks.
recipe_steps: The logon pad with chime plinks.

name: Shutdown Fall
inspired_by: Windows XP Shutdown as a falling cadence instrument
character: A descending melancholic cadence, played chromatically.
